name: codecity-viewer
description: Explore mixed-language projects as interactive 3D code cities

scripts.test: node tests/unit.mjs && node --test tests/server.test.cjs tests/improvements.test.cjs tests/feedback.test.cjs tests/runtime.test.cjs tests/profile.test.cjs tests/history-blobs.test.cjs tests/exclusions.test.cjs tests/e2e_playwright.mjs
scripts.package:vscode: node scripts/bundle-vscode.cjs && cd extensions/vscode && npx @vscode/vsce package --githubBranch main --baseContentUrl https://github.com/Amin-Tgz/CodeCity/blob/main/extensions/vscode/ --baseImagesUrl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Amin-Tgz/CodeCity/main/extensions/vscode/
